title: Administration of Anti-anxiety Medicine Prior to Foley Catheter Removal After HoLEP
official: A Single-Center, Randomized, Double-Blind Trial Comparing Lorazepam, Mirtazapine, and Acetaminophen Administered Prior to Foley Catheter Removal After Holmium Laser Enucleation of the Prostate (HoLEP)
summary: The investigator and research team plan to assess if administering Lorazepam or Mirtazapine compared to Acetaminophen prior to catheter removal after Holmium Laser Enucleation of the Prostate (HoLEP) improves same day trial of void (postop urination) success rates.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

\- Individuals undergoing HoLEP for the treatment of bothersome lower urinary tract symptoms

Exclusion Criteria:

* Individuals with a known allergy or contraindication to Lorazepam, Mirtazapine or Acetaminophen
* Individuals with current chronic benzodiazepine use or history of benzodiazepine use disorder
* Severe hepatic (Child-Pugh C) or renal (eGFR \< 30mL/min) impairment
* Any intraoperative complication necessitating prolonged catheterization or ICU admission (will be unenrolled from the study)
* Planned overnight admission due to any medical or social reasons
* Individuals who are unable to take oral medications
* Individuals who lack decisional capacity
* Individuals who are unable to read/speak English
